+ def run_function_calling(query: str, functions: List[Dict[str, Any]], function_map: Dict[str, callable]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+     """
+     Execute function calling with OpenAI API
+     
+     Args:
+         query: User query text
+         functions: List of function definitions in OpenAI format
+         function_map: Dictionary mapping function names to actual callable functions
+         
+     Returns:
+         Response from the model with function calling results
+     """
+     # First model call to get function call
+     messages = [{"role": "user", "content": query}]
+     response = model_client.chat.completions.create(
+         model="claude-3-opus-20240229",
+         messages=messages,
+         tools=functions,
+         tool_choice="auto"
+     )
+     
+     message = response.choices[0].message
+     
+     # Check if the model wants to call a function
+     if not message.tool_calls:
+         # No function call needed, return the response
+         return {"response": message.content, "function_call": None}
+     
+     # Process function calls
+     function_name = message.tool_calls[0].function.name
+     function_args = json.loads(message.tool_calls[0].function.arguments)
+     
+     # Execute the function
+     if function_name not in function_map:
+         return {"response": f"Error: Function {function_name} not found", "function_call": None}
+     
+     function_response = function_map[function_name](**function_args)
+     
+     # Second model call to get final response with function results
+     messages.append(message)
+     messages.append({
+         "role": "tool",
+         "tool_call_id": message.tool_calls[0].id,
+         "name": function_name,
+         "content": json.dumps(function_response)
+     })
+     
+     second_response = model_client.chat.completions.create(
+         model="claude-3-opus-20240229",
+         messages=messages
+     )
+     
+     return {
+         "response": second_response.choices[0].message.content,
+         "function_call": {
+             "name": function_name,
+             "arguments": function_args,
+             "result": function_response
+         }
+     }
+ 
+ # Example usage:
+ # functions = [
+ #     {
+ #         "type": "function",
+ #         "function": {
+ #             "name": "list_projects",
+ #             "description": "List all projects for a user",
+ #             "parameters": {
